title: Some of my “dream scenes”…
content: Long time lurker, first time poster, I think this might actually be my very first Reddit post ever…I know, I know, but please understand I’m not as technologically inclined as most people my age (35F), now with all that being said onwards to my post content. I’ve been having “the dreams” for a very long time now, I can actually recall a few of the first ones that I had as a child, I’ve always had strange vivid dreams and nightmares and a while back my Husband suggested I start a dream journal so I did (he’s also the one who first told me about “the mall world” when I was describing my dream mall to him one day and thats how I found this community to begin with)… …over the past several months I’ve jotted down a few dreams here and there (when I can remember), recently Hubby showed me how to use AI to create what I’ve been calling my “dream scenes” and I just wanted to share some of the album I’ve comprised to see if any of these locations are familiar to any of you. I tried to be as detailed as possible and some of them got extremely close, I really enjoyed making them and I’d love to share some others in the future.
